title: Awesome app, great team 🚀
body: I love that this app solves a very specific problem that is infuriatingly overlooked by every other bloated productivity tool in the world: how to actually get the work done once you’ve made a nice, tidy list. I’ve always struggled with this and my challenges with planning, task initiation and debilitating time blindness have left me feeling frazzled, stressed and chronically behind schedule. Llama life helps with all of this. It’s a joy to use an app that is so clearly created by people that have the same struggles. Yay!
author: Napper13
